violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The back of the monitors in the kitchen need to be cleaned.

Prep/vegetable sink. — --Designated prep sink was not provided or not used for food items requiring washing/soaking. The designated food prep sink has been removed. This was done to move the ice machine to that location to add another grill in the kitchen. They do not have a designated food prep sink, nor a variance to use the sanitize sink on the three compartment sink. DOH Note: A separate designated food prep sink must be reinstalled.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. -First hand sink out of paper towels
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
